name: DeathXDigivolution!
main_effect:
While you have an [X Antibody] trait Digimon, you can ignore this card's color requirements..
[Main] Digivolve 1 of your Digimon into a Digimon card with [Dex] or [DeathX] in its name from your trash by paying its memory cost.
